action_plan.title: Wire a Decart-class world model into a GCC pitch this week
action_plan.body: The world-model layer just became a per-second API at $0.02/sec. R&D should stand up a live Riyadh or Doha drive-through demo on Oasis-class infrastructure and drop it into the next deck before competitors do.

action_plan.title: Open the UAE Federal AI Authority door
action_plan.body: A new federal AI body just consolidated everything from data to digital government under one umbrella. The partnerships function should send a positioning letter and a single-page capability brief to the Authority's secretariat within the next 7 days.

action_plan.title: Build a privacy-first smart-glasses pitch line
action_plan.body: Meta's facial recognition retreat just opened a positioning gap on consent-by-design AR. The creative leads should package a no-FRT, on-device, opt-in spec sheet and offer it as an option in every glasses-related conversation.

action_plan.title: Treat splat capture as dual-use data from now on
action_plan.body: Pokémon GO scans now feed military drone navigation. Whoever owns the capture pipeline should add a data-use clause to client splat contracts and a kill-switch for sensitive sites — before a Gulf client asks the question first.

coming_next.headline: Cannes Lions opens June 22 with an AI-only Creative Brand Lion category.
coming_next.body: Cannes Lions 2026 runs 22–26 June and has explicitly tilted the festival toward AI, creators and sports — the moment to plant ARlab's flag in the European creative conversation.

coming_next.headline: Riyadh stages its first Global AI Show June 29–30.
coming_next.body: GAIS Riyadh is the Year-of-AI flagship gathering and the natural follow-up to the new UAE Federal AI Authority announcement — a single trip can hit both buyer pools.

coming_next.headline: AI Engineer World's Fair lands in San Francisco June 29–July 2.
coming_next.body: Co-located with ACM CAIS 2026, this is where MCP, agents and tooling are being argued out in public — sharp signal for the studio's own agent layer.

coming_next.headline: visionOS 27 public release ships this fall with Gemini-powered Siri.
coming_next.body: Beta is already in developer hands; Apple's confirmed visionOS 27 ships in fall with Visual Intelligence, spatial panoramas and Maps upgrades — the window to launch a flagship Vision Pro experience is now.

first_of_kind.name: Decart Oasis 3
first_of_kind.body: A real-time world model that simulates hours of photorealistic driving on demand, priced at $0.02/sec via API. Decart closed a $300M round at $4B the same week — world models are now a metered cloud service, not a research demo.

first_of_kind.name: NVIDIA Cosmos 3
first_of_kind.body: NVIDIA's new open foundation model for physical AI and robotics, positioned as the base layer for simulation, embodied agents and next-gen robots. Open weights make it a credible substrate for any studio building location-grounded experiences.

first_of_kind.name: Tencent HY-World 2.0
first_of_kind.body: A multi-modal world model for reconstructing, generating and simulating 3D worlds, released openly on GitHub three weeks ago. It quietly puts Tencent in the same conversation as Genie 3 and Marble — and the code is in our hands.

first_of_kind.name: GenRecon
first_of_kind.body: A May 2026 method that fuses generative 3D priors with multi-view reconstruction, closing the gap between scanned reality and synthesised geometry. The architecture is a roadmap for next-gen splat-plus-AI hybrid pipelines.

partners.name: Decart
partners.body: Just raised $300M at $4B and shipped Oasis 3 as an API — the cleanest way to drop a live, photorealistic environment behind a brand experience without an engine.

partners.name: Krea AI
partners.body: Open-sourced Realtime 14B for long-form real-time video — a self-hostable engine for live, generative installations and OOH.

partners.name: Hyper3D (Rodin Gen 2)
partners.body: AI 3D model editing, not just generation — the missing tool for branded assets that need to be revised on the fly in a pitch room.

partners.name: World Labs
partners.body: Fei-Fei Li's lab shipped Marble 1.1 Plus and is the cleanest API for prompt-to-explorable-3D — the right substrate for landmark recreations.

partners.name: Sony XYN
partners.body: Sony's pro Spatial Capture Solution turns real-world environments into high-quality 3DCG — the studio-grade upgrade path beyond phone splats.

partners.name: Moonshot · Kimi K2.7
partners.body: Open 1-trillion-parameter coding model released this week — a credible self-hosted alternative for the studio's internal agent layer and MCP tooling.

patterns.headline: Frontier AI is now a state-controlled asset, not a product.
patterns.body: When Washington can flip a model off worldwide in a day — as it just did to Claude Fable 5 — every studio building on top of an LLM is one export-control directive away from a dead client deliverable. Multi-model resilience just stopped being a nice-to-have.

patterns.headline: World models left the lab and became metered APIs.
patterns.body: Decart Oasis 3 at $0.02/sec, NVIDIA Cosmos 3 open-weighted, Tencent HY-World 2.0 on GitHub, World Labs' Marble shipping — in a single quarter, the world-model layer became something you bill, not something you read papers about.

patterns.headline: User-captured 3D is the next dual-use battleground.
patterns.body: Pokémon GO scans now feed military drone navigation; Meta tried to embed face recognition into its smart-glasses companion app. Every splat you capture and every camera you ship is now both an asset and a liability — the privacy floor on AR has shifted upward.

patterns.headline: The Gulf is collapsing AI governance into single federal desks.
patterns.body: The UAE just stood up a Federal Authority for AI and Data under Sheikh Mohammed, unifying AI, data and digital government in one body. Combined with Saudi's Year of AI and the DISAI cohort, the region's AI spend is now routed through fewer, more powerful gatekeepers — the partnerships game is winnable, but only by those at the right table.

signals.headline: Washington just switched off the world's most powerful Anthropic model.
signals.body: On June 12, a US export-control directive forced Anthropic to disable Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 worldwide over a reported jailbreak — even foreign-national Anthropic employees lost access. Anthropic confirmed it cannot filter foreign users from US users in real time, so the only available action was a full shutdown. Frontier AI is now a regulated dual-use export, not a SaaS product.
signals.arlab_use: build every client deliverable against at least two model vendors — never single-vendor.

signals.headline: World models just became a metered cloud service.
signals.body: Decart launched Oasis 3 on June 10 — an interactive world model that simulates hours of photorealistic driving, served via API at $0.02 per second. The company simultaneously closed a $300M round at a $4B valuation. The category shifted from research preview to credit-card pricing in one week.
signals.arlab_use: price a world-model rental into the next gcc pitch, not a custom build.

signals.headline: Pokémon GO scans are now training military drone navigation.
signals.body: Niantic Spatial's partnership with Vantor (formerly Maxar Intelligence) means hundreds of millions of voluntary player scans are now feeding GPS-denied drone navigation. Vantor recently won a $217M US Army contract for 3D terrain. Every gaussian splat capture is now dual-use data — and clients will start asking where the points go.
signals.arlab_use: add a data-use and kill-switch clause to every splat-capture contract.

signals.headline: Meta stripped facial recognition from its smart-glasses app within 24 hours of being caught.
signals.body: Wired found hidden face-recognition code in Meta's AI companion app for its smart glasses; the EFF escalated, and Meta pulled the code in under a day. The episode draws the privacy ceiling for any AR wearable that ships with a forward-facing camera — and re-opens the positioning space for consent-by-design experiences.
signals.arlab_use: sell consent-by-design as a feature on every glasses brief from now on.

signals.headline: The UAE just consolidated all AI authority under one federal desk.
signals.body: On June 14, Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid announced the Federal Authority for Artificial Intelligence and Data — a single national body unifying AI oversight, data governance and digital government. It will operate under Omar Sultan Al Olama's portfolio, making it the new single procurement door for AI-touching work across the Emirates.
signals.arlab_use: map every uae prospect to the new authority's remit before the next outreach round.

signals.headline: visionOS 27 turned out to be a much bigger upgrade than Apple let on at WWDC.
signals.body: Post-keynote analysis from UploadVR and developers in the beta reveals Gemini-powered Visual Siri, spatial panoramas, screen recording, expanded Apple Intelligence APIs and a long list of refinements Apple barely mentioned on stage. The Vision Pro story for fall just became materially more compelling — and the SDK is in developers' hands now.
signals.arlab_use: prototype a flagship visionos 27 piece before the public release window closes.

tools.name: Decart Oasis 3
tools.body: Real-time interactive world model served via API at $0.02/sec — drop a photorealistic environment into any pitch without rendering or modelling.

tools.name: Kimi K2.7 Code
tools.body: Open-source 1-trillion-parameter agentic coding model from Moonshot, released this week on Hugging Face — a self-hostable alternative to Claude Code for the studio's pipeline.

tools.name: Midjourney V8.1
tools.body: Became default on June 10 — about 5x faster than V8, native HD 2K, and stronger small-detail retention; the new baseline for board-ready stills.

tools.name: Rodin Gen 2
tools.body: AI 3D model editing, not just generation — adjust topology, materials and proportions of generated assets on the fly. The missing piece for fast branded 3D revisions.

tools.name: Tencent HY-World 2.0
tools.body: Open-source multi-modal world model on GitHub — reconstruct, generate and simulate 3D worlds locally without sending client geometry to an API.

tools.name: visionOS 27 Developer Beta
tools.body: Apple's spatial OS with Visual Intelligence, spatial panoramas and expanded Apple Intelligence APIs — SDK is live, public release is fall. Build now, ship at launch.

undisclosed.name: Pokémon GO's quiet pivot into defence
undisclosed.body: Niantic Spatial has fused player-generated 3D scans with Vantor's aerial navigation for GPS-denied military drones, confirmed June 9. Vantor has a $217M US Army contract on the books. Every consumer-grade splat platform is now a potential defence supplier — and clients will ask.

undisclosed.name: Meta's hidden face-recognition code
undisclosed.body: Wired uncovered unreleased facial-recognition code embedded in Meta's smart-glasses companion app; the EFF went public and Meta stripped it within 24 hours. The episode confirms Meta intended ambient identification in the wearable — and was only stopped by exposure.

undisclosed.name: Anthropic's safety warning backfire
undisclosed.body: Days after Anthropic publicly warned that AI was becoming too dangerous, the US government cited those same arguments to force the shutdown of Fable 5 and Mythos 5. The lesson: public safety posturing is now a regulatory attack vector against the company posturing.

undisclosed.name: DISAI 2026 — Saudi's stealth cohort
undisclosed.body: Qualcomm, Aramco, RDIA and HUMAIN quietly named 10 startups selected for the Design in Saudi Arabia with AI 2026 programme. This is the Kingdom's most strategic AI-startup landing pad of the Year of AI — and partner slots are easier to win now than in twelve months.
